name: Is it better to frame a basement with wood studs or metal studs?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to frame a basement with wood studs or metal studs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional 2x4 wood studs remain the standard choice for most residential basement finishing projects because they offer structural rigidity, ease of attaching heavy items like cabinets or wall-mounted TVs, and seamless integration with finish carpentry. Steel studs offer excellent straightness, do not rot, and resist insects, but they require specialized fasteners and can make hanging heavy shelves more complicated. As a hands-on finish carpentry team, we typically recommend wood framing with pressure-treated base plates to ensure secure fastening for baseboards, drywall, and custom trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wood studs are generally preferred for residential basements because they simplify drywall hanging, cabinetry mounting, and detailed finish carpentry.
